apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Service Role Key (for actions) or Anonymous Key (for basic triggers). Find your keys in Settings, API, Project API keys.

create_row.label: Create Row
create_row.description: Create a new row in a table

table_name.label: Table
table_name.description: Only tables exposed through the Supabase Data API can be used.

row_data.label: Row Data
row_data.description: The new row, as a JSON object with one field per column.

return_row.label: Return Created Row
return_row.description: When off, the step outputs nothing.

delete_rows.label: Delete Rows
delete_rows.description: Remove rows matching filter criteria from a table

table_name.label: Table
table_name.description: Only tables exposed through the Supabase Data API can be used.

filter_column.label: Column
filter_column.description: Rows are matched on this column.

filter_type.label: Condition
filter_type.description: How the column is compared with the value.

filter_value.label: Value
filter_value.description: Not used by Is one of, Is null or Is not null.

filter_values.label: Values
filter_values.description: Used only by Is one of, as a JSON list such as ["a", "b"].

return_deleted.label: Return Deleted Rows
return_deleted.description: Adds the deleted rows to the output.

delete_rows.afterResponse: return inputs.return_deleted === 'true' ? {success: true, deleted_rows: response} : {success: true};

update_row.label: Update Row
update_row.description: Update rows in a table based on filter criteria

table_name.label: Table
table_name.description: Only tables exposed through the Supabase Data API can be used.

filter_column.label: Column
filter_column.description: Rows are matched on this column.

filter_type.label: Condition
filter_type.description: How the column is compared with the value.

filter_value.label: Value
filter_value.description: Used by every condition except Is one of.

filter_values.label: Values
filter_values.description: Used only by Is one of, as a JSON list such as ["a", "b"].

update_data.label: New Values
update_data.description: The new values, as a JSON object with one field per column.

return_updated.label: Return Updated Rows
return_updated.description: Adds the updated rows to the output.

update_row.afterResponse: return inputs.return_updated === 'true' ? {success: true, updated_rows: response} : {success: true};

upsert_row.label: Upsert Row
upsert_row.description: Insert or update a row in a table

table_name.label: Table
table_name.description: Only tables exposed through the Supabase Data API can be used.

on_conflict.label: Match Column
on_conflict.description: A unique column. Rows with the same value here are updated.

row_data.label: Row Data
row_data.description: The row, as a JSON object with one field per column.

return_upserted.label: Return Upserted Rows
return_upserted.description: Adds the written rows to the output.

upsert_row.afterResponse: return inputs.return_upserted === 'true' ? {success: true, upserted_rows: response} : {success: true};

search_rows.label: Search Rows
search_rows.description: Search for rows in a table with filters and pagination

table_name.label: Table
table_name.description: Only tables exposed through the Supabase Data API can be used.

columns.label: Columns
columns.description: Comma-separated. Leave empty to return every column.

filters.label: Filters
filters.description: A row is returned only if it matches every filter: a JSON list of {"field", "operator", "value"}, where operator is eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, ilike, is, in, contains or containedBy. Use -> in field for a JSON key; for in, separate values with commas.

create_bucket.label: Create Storage Bucket
create_bucket.description: Creates a new Storage bucket, public or private.

name.label: Bucket Name
name.description: Must be unique in the project.

public.label: Public
public.description: Whether files in this bucket are publicly readable by URL.

fileSizeLimit.label: Max File Size
fileSizeLimit.description: In bytes. Empty uses the project's upload limit.

list_buckets.label: List Storage Buckets
list_buckets.description: Lists all Storage buckets in the project.
list_buckets.afterResponse: return {buckets: (Array.isArray(response) ? response : []).map((b) => ({id: b.id, name: b.name, public: b.public, created_at: b.created_at, updated_at: b.updated_at}))};

list_files.label: List Files in Bucket
list_files.description: Lists files and folders inside a Storage bucket, optionally under a specific folder path.

bucket.label: Bucket
bucket.description: The bucket's name, as shown in Storage.

path.label: Folder Path
path.description: Leave empty to list the bucket root.

list_users.label: List Users
list_users.description: Lists the users registered in the project's Auth system. Requires the Service Role Key.

perPage.label: Users Per Page
perPage.description: How many users each page returns.

list_users.beforeRequest:
request.query = {page: String(Number(inputs.page) || 1), per_page: String(Number(inputs.perPage) || 50)};
return request;
list_users.afterResponse: return {users: (response.users ?? []).map((u) => ({id: u.id, email: u.email ?? null, phone: u.phone ?? null, created_at: u.created_at, last_sign_in_at: u.last_sign_in_at ?? null, confirmed_at: u.confirmed_at ?? null}))};

get_user.label: Get User
get_user.description: Gets a single user's Auth record by ID. Requires the Service Role Key.

userId.label: User ID
userId.description: Find it under Authentication, Users in Supabase.

get_user.afterResponse:
const user = response.user ?? response;
return {id: user.id, email: user.email ?? null, phone: user.phone ?? null, user_metadata: user.user_metadata ?? {}, app_metadata: user.app_metadata ?? {}, created_at: user.created_at, last_sign_in_at: user.last_sign_in_at ?? null, confirmed_at: user.confirmed_at ?? null};

create_user.label: Create User
create_user.description: Creates a user in Supabase Auth. Requires the Service Role Key.

email.label: Email
email.description: Enter an email, a phone number, or both.

emailConfirm.label: Mark Email as Confirmed
emailConfirm.description: Lets the user sign in without confirming by email.

userMetadata.label: User Metadata
userMetadata.description: Custom data saved on the user, as JSON.

create_user.beforeRequest:
if (!inputs.email && !inputs.phone) throw new Error('Either Email or Phone must be provided.');
return request;
create_user.afterResponse:
const user = response.user ?? response;
return {id: user.id, email: user.email ?? null, phone: user.phone ?? null, created_at: user.created_at};

update_user.label: Update User
update_user.description: Updates a user's email, phone, password, or metadata. Requires the Service Role Key.

userId.label: User ID
userId.description: Find it under Authentication, Users in Supabase.

email.label: Email
email.description: Empty email, phone and password keep their current value.

password.label: Password
password.description: Leave empty to keep the current password.

userMetadata.label: User Metadata
userMetadata.description: Custom data saved on the user, as JSON.

update_user.afterResponse:
const user = response.user ?? response;
return {id: user.id, email: user.email ?? null, phone: user.phone ?? null, updated_at: user.updated_at ?? null};

invite_user.label: Invite User by Email
invite_user.description: Sends an invite email to a new user, who sets their own password when accepting. Requires the Service Role Key.

userMetadata.label: User Metadata
userMetadata.description: Custom data saved on the user, as JSON.

redirectTo.label: Redirect URL
redirectTo.description: Page the user lands on after accepting.

invite_user.afterResponse:
const user = response.user ?? response;
return {id: user.id, email: user.email ?? null, invited_at: user.invited_at ?? null};
